parsed.explanation: The averaging denominator is wrong: the listed 2^{n+1}-2 proper nonempty subset sums yield only 2^{n+1}-3 internal gaps, so this proves at best a gap below 1/(2^{n+1}-3), not d. The correct bound follows by including the empty and full subset sums: then 2^{n+1} values in [0,1] have 2^{n+1}-1 consecutive gaps totaling 1. No other passage supplies the missing all-divisions pigeonhole bound; the earlier summaries merely assert it.
